name: Build A Dream
summary: Teams build bicycles, children are revealed as the recipients, teams present and fit the bikes, then a facilitated debrief.
source: Modeled from Ledgebrook 2026-09-16 run of show and DeVry Building a Dream 2011-12-09 agenda.

documents.title: {{beneficiary_org}} coordination letter
documents.purpose: Sent about three weeks out. Tells the club or school when to arrive, how many children to select, what to bring, and who holds custody.

body: It was a pleasure speaking with you about our {{name}} event. We are very excited to have the {{beneficiary_org}} involved in this event.
Here are some details for you...

sections.heading: WHEN
body: {{delivery_date}}
Children arrive on site at {{arrive_venue_time}} to approximately {{depart_venue_time}}

sections.heading: WHERE
body: {{venue_name}}
{{venue_address}}
{{venue_phone}}
The room is {{holding_room}}. I will be in touch the day before and the day of the event to be sure we are on track and to give you any additional details.

sections.heading: WHO
body: {{client_descriptor}} is holding a leadership event for {{participants}} leaders. The bicycle build is the closing session.

sections.heading: BEFORE THE EVENT: OFFSITE COORDINATION
body: We will be building {{beneficiaries}} bicycles for {{beneficiaries}} children. We ask that you select {{beneficiaries}} children, between {{age_min}} and {{age_max}} years old ({{wheel_size_in}} inch bicycles), from your club who you feel will most benefit from receiving a brand new bicycle.
We are expecting {{beneficiary_transport_by}} to provide transportation of the children to and from the location listed above.
Please send me the first name and age of each child once your list is set, along with the names of the staff who will accompany them.

sections.heading: PARAGRAPHS
body: These are optional. If the children have time to do them, the adults love them, and they are one of the most meaningful parts of the day for the people building the bicycles.
Here are some guidelines for the paragraphs:
bullets: One paragraph from each child who will be receiving the bicycle.

Please have the kids write a paragraph about what their life would be like with a bicycle. What does it mean to have a bicycle? Do they feel excited? Do they feel proud? Where will they go with their bicycle?
Have them sign the paragraph with their name.
Please bring the paragraphs with you to the event.

sections.heading: DRAWINGS
body: Also optional, and also a favorite of the adults. It can be both drawings and paragraphs or neither. Just one small part of reciprocating that helps the children accept the bike because they are giving too.
bullets: Please have the kids draw a picture of them riding a bicycle.
Please only have them draw; no words.
Have them write their name on the BACK of the drawing.
If doing them, please bring the drawings with you to the event. They are given to the adults who built the bicycles.

sections.heading: DURING THE EVENT: ONSITE COORDINATION
body: Please arrive at the holding room ({{holding_room}}) by {{arrive_venue_time}}. {{greeter_name}} will meet you in the lobby and walk you to the holding room. This can be a large venue and it may take some time to find each other and get to the room, so arriving fifteen minutes earlier may be better.
We will provide drinks for the children while they wait.

Each child will be paired with one adult from a team. The purpose of the pairing is to make the child as comfortable as possible. Those adults stay with the children and walk them into the room when the bicycles are revealed.
I will check in with you shortly after you arrive and will be back roughly five minutes before the reveal to guide you to the doors. The reveal is expected at approximately {{reveal}}.

Upon entering the build room, each child will go with their adult buddy to a group of adults and be presented with their bicycle. They will be with the adults for roughly {{time_with_children_min}} minutes. We will take a group photo, the children will exit through a tunnel of adults, and then we will say goodbye. The children should be on their way by approximately {{depart_venue_time}}.
Each child will also receive a helmet, lock, and backpack while in the room. These go home with the child that evening.

sections.heading: AFTER THE EVENT: TRANSPORTATION OF BIKES
body: Every bicycle is inspected and corrected by a Be Legendary bicycle technician after the program, at the venue, before it leaves. We will then transport the bicycles to the {{beneficiary_org}} that evening. We expect to arrive by approximately {{bike_delivery_eta}}. Please be sure someone is there to meet us so the bicycles can be dropped off.
Please do not tell the children they can pick up their bicycles that night until our technicians have completed their inspection and the bicycles have arrived.

sections.heading: A NOTE ON THE CHILDREN
body: The {{beneficiary_org}} retains legal custody and responsibility for the children throughout the event. Be Legendary staff supervise the children while they are in our care at the venue, in coordination with your staff. Please plan to have your staff with the children at all times.

sections.heading: THANK YOU
body: Thank you so much for being a part of this event. It really is a joy to be a part of, and I know you, your staff, and the children will be thrilled.
Please don't hesitate to contact me with any questions or concerns.
